text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the fulfilling summer training camp having come to an end,
as for Gentildonna—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Facility Administrator
text_block_list.text:
"W-Woah...!
A rusted padlock, popped open with just a flick of her nail...!"

text_block_list.name: Facility Administrator
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
This storage room has been locked away forever...
Now we can finally organize it~!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for thanks.
It was no more trouble than swatting a horsefly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During this summer training camp, Gentildonna's power was further refined, and her aura of absolute strength grew even more formidable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Kyaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by a massive entourage, arriving with complete composure was—Orfevre.
Last year's Classic Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Vassals
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfe!
You're sweating... Allow me to wipe it for you!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Don't touch me.

text_block_list.name: Vassals
text_block_list.text:
Aah,
I-I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...My, you seem to be in quite a sour mood.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you're still hung up
on that crushing defeat this spring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After achieving the Triple Crown, Orfevre secured a brilliant victory
in the year-end Grand Prix, the Arima Kinen.
She was even named Horse Girl of the Year, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this year's Tenno Sho (Spring), she suffered an inexplicable, crushing defeat, finishing in 11th place.
Though she managed to bounce back afterward...
choice_data_list: (Provoking them so openly, of all things...)

text_block_list.name: Vassals
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a second...!
G-Gentildonna-san,
are you intending to insult Lord Orfevre!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...What poorly trained
lapdogs they are."

text_block_list.name: Vassals
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Orfevre-san, I was speaking to you, you know—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Step aside, insolent fool.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Do not stand directly before me.
You do not yet wear enough crowns.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
“—Or do you truly believe you can stand alongside Us
and pass beneath the Arc de Triomphe?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Talk of it had been going around for a while. That Orfevre would challenge the pinnacle of world racing, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—heights Japan has yet to reach..."
choice_data_list: (There will definitely be more eyes on this than ever before.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
Please pardon my rudeness.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Until the end of autumn, then.
—Once I have earned the right, I shall give you my proper greetings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that tense moment earlier...
Gentildonna showed no anger toward the arrogant Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I asked for the reason—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
She is a victor, after all.
And currently the one wielding the greatest power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Those with power simply act accordingly.
I hold no resentment whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, might makes right.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Their reign will be brief anyway.
Let's just let them act as they please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna undoubtedly has Orfevre in her sights...
and the gap between them is steadily closing.
choice_data_list: Let's bring home a victory at the Shuka Sho as a souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That is a splendid proposal.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Right, first is autumn.
There's something to look forward to at the start of autumn.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It seems there are some who are
already raring to go, too—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—...Ngh, alright!
I've finally... caught up to you...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Her running from back then...
That strength etched into my body—and the frustration...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Indeed, she surpassed it...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Fufufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile...
I suppose I shouldn't have asked to train alongside you after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—The me right now can surpass you!
The Shuka Sho... is mine...!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big siiiiis!
The bus is gonna leave without us~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, wait up!
I'll be right there!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Ah, I can hardly wait.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
We have gathered our strength,
and both you all and I have grown stronger.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
An autumn where we can clash with everything we have—
and surpass it all.
choice_data_list: The further you push past your limits, the higher the heights you can see.
The further you push past your limits, the higher the heights you can see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely.
—I'm sure it's a magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just a little longer until the final crown of the Tiara route,
the Shuka Sho—
